research_questions.question: Wat is de voorspelkracht van het model op basis van het huidig inkomen vergeleken met meer uitgebreide modellen?
research_questions.witness: In het empirisch onderzoek naar de voorspelkracht van verschillende modellen voor bestendig inkomen vergelijken we de voorspelkracht van het model op basis van de TR, dat primair gebruikmaakt van het huidig inkomen, met meer uitgebreide modellen.

research_questions.question_en: How does the predictive power change when the current model is supplemented with background characteristics?

research_questions.question_en: How do the models and their predictive power differ between different target groups?

data_mentions.witness: Voor dit rapport hebben in het Nationaal Sportonderzoek NSO in het najaar van 2020 vragen aan de bevolking (16–80 jaar) over thuissport meegelopen.
Het tweede onderzoek waar we in dit rapport gebruik van maken is de Vrijetijdsomnibus (VTO). Dit onderzoek bestaat sinds 2012 en wordt om de twee jaar uitgevoerd.
Eveneens van het SCP/CBS is het Tijdbestedingsonderzoek (TBO). Voor dit onderzoek registreren respondenten gedurende een week hun activiteiten.
Het CBS maakt gebruik van steekproeven uit het bevolkingsregister.
Voor dit onderzoek registreren respondenten gedurende een week hun activiteiten. Ook dit onderzoek maakt gebruik van een steekproef uit het bevolkingsregister.
Als we aan (volwassen) sporters vragen op welke plekken ze in het afgelopen jaar hebben gesport, geeft 32 procent aan (ook) thuis of in de tuin te hebben gesport (NSO najaar 2020, tabel 3.1).
Opvallend is dat mannen minder aan thuissport doen dan vrouwen (tabel 3.2; resp. 23% en 42%).
Uit de gegevens uit het NSO najaar 2020 blijkt dat 39 procent van de Nederlandse bevolking zijn of haar sportgedrag heeft aangepast als gevolg van de coronamaatregelen.
Volgens het NSO (najaar 2020; niet in tabel) is yoga na fitness de populairste thuissport (17%).
Uit de resultaten van het NSO 2020 (tabel 4.2) blijkt de yogamat het meest gebruikte hulpmiddel te zijn bij sportactiviteiten thuis of in de eigen tuin (53%).
De importcijfers van Eurostat (2020) ondersteunen deze bevinding.
In Nederland staan in 2019 5 miljoen eengezinswoningen, die meestal een tuin hebben, en 2,8 miljoen appartementen, die deze doorgaans niet hebben (CBS, 2020).
Het volgen van lessen en instructies stimuleert thuissporters om vol te houden (49%; tabel 4.4).
Gemiddeld kijken per uitzending in 2019 56.000 mensen naar het programma (tabel 4.5).
Uit tabel 4.6 blijkt dat de woonkamer het meest gebruikt wordt (47%).
Ten opzichte van de bevolking zijn zij relatief jong en hoger opgeleid (tabel 5.1).
Zo sport van hen 46 procent 120 keer of vaker per jaar, tegenover 36 procent van de sporters in het algemeen (tabel 5.2).
In het NSO (najaar 2020) hebben we vastgesteld met welke frequentie iemand thuis sport.
Daarnaast is de tevredenheid groot over de mogelijkheden om te fietsen en wandelen in de buurt.

research_questions.question: Hoe kunnen verenigingsbestuurders, coaches, trainers, ouders, vrijwilligers en andere betrokkenen handelen om een plezierige, eerlijke, veilige en zorgeloze sportervaring voor de leden van een amateursportvereniging te realiseren?
research_questions.witness:
Doel van het boek
Dit boek heeft als doel te beschrijven hoe verenigingsbestuurders, coaches, trainers, ouders, vrijwilligers en andere betrokkenen handelen om een plezierige, eerlijke, veilige en zorgeloze sportervaring voor de leden van een amateursportvereniging te realiseren en tegen welke barrières zij hierbij aanlopen.
research_questions.question_en: How can association board members, coaches, trainers, parents, volunteers, and other stakeholders act to realize a pleasant, fair, safe, and carefree sports experience for the members of an amateur sports association?

research_questions.question: Wat zijn de handelingsproblemen waarmee sportverenigingen worden geconfronteerd bij het garanderen van een positieve sportcultuur?
research_questions.witness: In de hoofdstukken van dit boek behandelen we achtereenvolgens hoe sportverenigingen omgaan met kansspelen, seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag, racisme, homonegativiteit, criminele inmenging, een pedagogisch sportklimaat en onsportief wedstrijdgedrag. Ook laten we zien met welke handelingsproblemen zij worden geconfronteerd.
research_questions.question_en: What are the practical challenges sports associations face in ensuring a positive sports culture?

research_questions.question: Hoe kan een positieve sportcultuur bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van jonge sporters?
research_questions.witness: De theorie van positieve jeugdontwikkeling zet in op het versterken van een vijftal kerncompetenties bij jonge sporters: eigen keuzes maken en gespreksvaardigheden verbeteren, een sterker zelfbeeld, waardevolle relaties aangaan en onderhouden met andere sporters, karakter ontwikkelen en liefde en zorg uitdragen voor anderen in de sportomgeving (Lerner et al., 2005; Roth & Brooks-Gunn, 2003).
research_questions.question_en: How can a positive sports culture contribute to the development of young athletes?

data_mentions.witness: The Netherlands has nearly 8.2 million dwellings, of which approximately 57% are owner-occupied, and 43% are rental properties (CBS, 2024).

Energy efficiency technology adoption in the Netherlands shows varied progress across different energy-saving measures. Solar panels have achieved remarkable penetration, with approximately 52.7% of homeowners having installed systems by 2023 (CBS Microdata, 2023; Table A.22).

The present research leverages this opportunity by combining customer journey data from three major one-stop shop operators (Winst Uit Je Woning, Bureau voor Verduurzamen (BvV), and Reimarkt) with detailed household and dwelling characteristics from Statistics Netherlands (CBS) at the micro level.
Geographic scope encompasses the service areas of the three participating one-stop shops, which collectively cover 314 of the Netherlands' 342 municipalities (92%) (CBS, 2023).

Row houses represent the largest segment at approximately 35% of family dwellings, followed by detached houses at 20.5%, apartments at 15.8%, corner houses at 15%, and semi-detached homes at 13% (CBS Microdata, 2023; Table A.10).
CBS data indicates that detached houses consume approximately 2.6 times more natural gas than apartments, reflecting the heat loss of fully exposed façades, roofs, and ground floors (CBS, 2018).

data_mentions.mention: micro-level sociodemographic and dwelling data from CBS Statistics Netherlands
data_mentions.witness: This research exploits data from three one-stop shop operators with distinctly different business models: Winst Uit Je Woning (WUJW), which operated through direct collaboration with Dutch municipalities, Bureau voor Verduurzamen (BvV), and Reimarkt, which used a market-based approach. While all three organisations provided integrated energy retrofit services, their approaches differed. WUJW leveraged municipal credibility and outreach infrastructure, while BvV and Reimarkt used diverse channels and execution strategies while still providing advice, contractor coordination, and quality assurance that characterise the one-stop shop model.

De verdachtenregistratie van de politie bevat gegevens over alle personen die in een bepaald jaar voorkomen in het registratiesysteem van de Nationale Politie.
De bestanden van het OM bevatten jaarlijkse gegevens over alle rechtbankstrafzaken die dat jaar zijn afgedaan door het OM.
De bestanden van de rechter bevatten vergelijkbare jaarlijkse gegevens over alle rechtbankstrafzaken die zijn afgedaan door de rechter in eerste aanleg.

Met betrekking tot opleidingsniveau kijken we bij meerderjarigen naar het hoogst behaalde opleidingsniveau op 1 januari van het peiljaar.
Op basis van informatie van het CBS over alle Nederlandse huishoudinkomens in het peiljaar is een indeling gemaakt in kwintielen.
Op basis van informatie van het CBS over alle Nederlandse huishoudinkomens in het peiljaar is een indeling gemaakt in kwintielen en gerangschikt van laag naar hoog.
We gebruiken hiertoe gegevens over het woonadres op 1 januari van het peiljaar.
Het adresseren van onze onderzoeksvraag aan de hand van microdata uit het Stelsel van Sociaal-statistische Bestanden (SSB) van het CBS biedt dan ook een aantal belangrijke innovaties.
Momenteel wist het CBS een deel van de verdachten uit de politiebestanden wanneer een zaak op bepaalde gronden is geseponeerd of als is vastgesteld dat er tegen een verdachte onvoldoende bewijs is.

title: De (spoor)weg naar werk? Arbeidsmarkteffecten van de opening van een nieuw treinstation

data_mentions.witness: We hebben eerst voor elke buurt in de gemeente Dronten onderzocht in hoeverre de ingebruikname van het station heeft geleid tot een verbetering van de ov-reistijd en het aantal met het ov te bereiken banen. Vervolgens hebben we alle personen (20-55 jaar) geselecteerd die op 1 maart 2012 woonden in één van de buurten waar de ov-bereikbaarheid van banen is verbeterd.

Voor de jaren in de periode 2006-2018 die de leden van deze onderzoekspopulatie in Dronten woonden, hebben we onderzocht hoe hun arbeidsmarktuitkomsten zijn veranderd in de zes jaren na de ingebruikname van het station (2013-2018) ten opzichte van de zeven jaren daarvoor (2006-2012).
We meten deze uitkomsten met behulp van gegevens uit twee registerbestanden die het CBS beschikbaar stelt voor onderzoek: de Sociaal-Statistisch Bestanden (SSB) en de Polisadministratie.

Zo raakte de financiële crisis in 2008 niet elke bedrijfstak even hard, wat zich vertaalde in verschillen in de banengroei en loonontwikkeling tussen bedrijfstakken in de jaren na 2008 (CBS 2017).

De komst van de Hanzelijn kan ertoe hebben geleid dat meer mensen dan voorheen in Dronten willen wonen. Om te zien of na de ingebruikname van het station in Dronten de groei van het aantal inwoners is veranderd, vergelijken we de ontwikkeling van het aantal inwoners tussen de 15 en 75 jaar van de gemeente Dronten in de jaren 2006-2018 met die van heel Nederland en de gemeenten die aan Dronten grenzen.

Om de werksituatie in kaart te brengen wordt gemeten of reclassenten over een baan beschikken op de peildatum of in het betreffende jaar. Dit wordt gemeten met de variabele IKVID, uit het bestand ‘Spolisbus’ van CBS-microdata (tabel 3).
Om de startpositie op de arbeidsmarkt inzichtelijk te maken wordt daarnaast het hoogst behaalde opleidingsniveau weergegeven, uit het bestand ‘HOOGSTEOPLTAB’ (tabel 4).
Ook wordt voor de volledigheid weergegeven hoeveel reclassenten zijn ingeschreven bij een opleiding, deze informatie staat in het bestand ‘ONDERWIJSINSCHRTAB’ (tabel 4).
Allereerst is op persoonlijk niveau (INPATAB) financiële onafhankelijkheid en het gemiddeld belastbaar inkomen inzichtelijk gemaakt.
Het gemiddelde vermogen van het huishouden en de schulden van het huishouden komen uit het bestand VEHTAB.
Tot slot is gekeken of reclassenten in de schuldsanering zitten met het bestand ‘Wet Schuldsanering Natuurlijke Personen’ (WSNP).
Dit bestand bevat personen die ingeschreven staan in de Gemeentelijke basisadministratie (GBA)
Om het werkzame leven van reclassenten in kaart te brengen, wordt gebruik gemaakt van het bestand SPOLIS, in dit bestand staan alle banen van alle werknemers in Nederland.
Aan het bestand Hoogste Opleiding kan 61% (n=50.159) van de reclassenten gekoppeld worden.
De sociaal economische categorie op maandbasis komt uit het bestand SECMBUS en geeft weer uit welke bron het voornaamste aandeel inkomen komt voor de betreffende maand.
Type 1 heeft in verhouding tot andere typen vaak een baan (35%) en blijft hier gemiddeld ook langer dan andere typen hangen (2,5 jaar, SD=3,2)

Eén van de mogelijkheden om inzichten op te doen ten behoeve van een woonlastenbenadering is het doen van onderzoek op lopende leningen die woningeigenaren hebben afgesloten voor verduurzaming van hun woning bij het Nationaal Energiebespaarfonds (NEF).

Van deze leningen is bekend welke maatregelen zijn getroffen en door koppeling met data van CBS kan worden onderzocht wat het energiegebruik voor en na het nemen van energiebesparende maatregelen is, waaruit de werkelijke energiebesparing kan worden berekend.
Het CBS heeft deze data via het adres gekoppeld met de klantenbestanden energie.
Ook heeft CBS de data gekoppeld met bij hen beschikbare databestanden over woningkenmerken en huishoudkenmerken en energielabels van RVO.
Het CBS ontvangt de klimaatgecorrigeerde energiegebruiksgegevens van gas en elektriciteit van de netbeheerders, het zogenaamde Standaard JaarVerbruik (SJV).

Van de 970 ingevulde enquêtes konden er 907 gematcht worden met het databestand van CBS.

research_questions.question: What is the impact of cycling on urban spatial structure and welfare?
research_questions.witness: This study examines the impact of cycling on urban spatial structure and welfare through the development of a quantitative spatial model that incorporates mode choice and car congestion.
research_questions.question_en: What is the impact of cycling on urban spatial structure and welfare?

research_questions.question: How does eliminating cycling affect commuting times, distances, and car congestion?
research_questions.witness: Eliminating cycling increases commuting times and distances by 14% and 30%, respectively, exacerbates car congestion, and results in a significant reduction in worker welfare.
research_questions.question_en: How does eliminating cycling affect commuting times, distances, and car congestion?

research_questions.question: What are the effects of removing dedicated cycleways on the spatial economy?
research_questions.witness: We also show that removing dedicated cycleways leads to similar, though less pronounced, changes in the spatial economy.
research_questions.question_en: What are the effects of removing dedicated cycleways on the spatial economy?

research_questions.question: Can promoting cycling help create more compact cities?
research_questions.witness: Therefore, promoting cycling can help create more compact cities.
research_questions.question_en: Can promoting cycling help create more compact cities?

research_questions.question: How does the substitution between travel modes affect the spatial economy, particularly when cycling is removed?
research_questions.witness: Consequently, the substitution patterns between travel modes is a key determinant of the effect of removing cycling on the spatial economy.
research_questions.question_en: How does the substitution between travel modes affect the spatial economy, particularly when cycling is removed?

research_questions.question: How does car congestion influence the effect of removing cycling on urban spatial structure?
research_questions.witness: This also raises the question how car congestion interferes with this conclusion. Does car congestion amplify or reduce the effect of removing cycling on the spatial Structure?
research_questions.question_en: How does car congestion influence the effect of removing cycling on urban spatial structure?

research_questions.question: To what extent does mode choice, particularly cycling, influence urban spatial structure?

research_questions.question: How are imperfections in different input markets related?
research_questions.witness: How are imperfections in different input markets related?
research_questions.question_en: How are imperfections in different input markets related?

research_questions.question: Can a model that combines monopsony, rent sharing, and buyer power rationalize the findings?
research_questions.witness: I show that these findings can be rationalized by a simple model that combines ingredients of the three strands of literature mentioned above – monopsony, rent sharing, and buyer power – but not by a model that considers imperfections in a single input market.
research_questions.question_en: Can a model that combines monopsony, rent sharing, and buyer power rationalize the findings?

research_questions.question: How do exchange rate variations affect markdowns and wages in firms that import intermediates from China?
research_questions.witness: I show that as the Euro appreciates, markdowns and rents in the intermediate input market of firms that import intermediates from China increase, and workers see their wages increase, even though labor does not become more revenue productive on average or on the margin.
research_questions.question_en: How do exchange rate variations affect markdowns and wages in firms that import intermediates from China?

research_questions.question: What is the prevalence of wage markups and wage markdowns in Dutch manufacturing?
research_questions.witness: I find that both wage markups and wage markdowns are prevalent in Dutch manufacturing, covering 50 percent of all observations each.
research_questions.question_en: What is the prevalence of wage markups and wage markdowns in Dutch manufacturing?

research_questions.question: What is the relationship between wage markups/markdowns and intermediate input wedges in Dutch manufacturing?
research_questions.witness: The two wedges are negatively correlated: underpaying suppliers on the margin relative to their revenue product coincides with overpaying workers on the margin.
research_questions.question_en: What is the relationship between wage markups/markdowns and intermediate input wedges in Dutch manufacturing?

research_questions.question: What factors contribute to the dispersion of labor wedge and input wedge distributions?
research_questions.witness: This dispersion is due mainly to idiosyncratic differences rather than between-industry differences or variation over time.
research_questions.question_en: What factors contribute to the dispersion of labor wedge and input wedge distributions?

research_questions.question: How does buyer power in the intermediate input market affect wage markups?
research_questions.witness: A key predictor of labor wedge dispersion is the degree of buyer power a firm has in the intermediate input market – as measured by the intermediate input wedge. The more a firm underpays its input suppliers on the margin, the higher its wages and wage markups.
research_questions.question_en: How does buyer power in the intermediate input market affect wage markups?

research_questions.question: How do exchange rate fluctuations affect input wedges and labor wedges?
research_questions.witness: Utilizing within-firm variation, I show that as the Euro appreciates, the intermediate input wedge increases, and the labor wedge decreases.
research_questions.question_en: How do exchange rate fluctuations affect input wedges and labor wedges?

We then match these women to their municipality of birth using the place of birth file (VRLGBAGEBOORTEGEMEENTE).

The parent-child registry (KINDOUDERTAB) is used link the women in our sample to their children so we can determine outcomes like age at first birth, as well as completed fertility (the youngest women in our sample were age 65 in 2018, implying that we observe them long past their prime childbearing ages).
The marital state register (GBABURGERLIJKSTESTAATBUS) contains information on all present and past marriages for individuals registered in a Dutch municipality from 1995.
We add information from the registry with information on the individual’s highest level of education (HOOGSTEOPLTAB).

research_questions.question: How much does moral opposition to birth control, and in particular the Pill, affect those who could potentially benefit from its effects?
research_questions.witness: Surprisingly little is known about how much moral opposition to birth control, and in particular the Pill, might affect those who could potentially benefit from its effects.
research_questions.question_en: How much does moral opposition to birth control, and in particular the Pill, affect those who could potentially benefit from its effects?

research_questions.question: What is the impact of the 1970 liberalization of the Pill for minors in the Netherlands on fertility, marriage, and human capital accumulation?
research_questions.witness: This paper presents new causal evidence on the “power” of oral contraceptives in shaping women’s lives, leveraging the 1970 liberalization of the Pill for minors in the Netherlands and demand- and supply-side religious preferences that affected Pill take-up.
research_questions.question_en: What is the impact of the 1970 liberalization of the Pill for minors in the Netherlands on fertility, marriage, and human capital accumulation?

research_questions.question: How do religious gatekeepers, such as general practitioners and pharmacists, affect the availability of the Pill?
research_questions.witness: We then show how these large effects were eliminated for women facing a higher share of gatekeepers – general practitioners and pharmacists – who were opposed to providing the Pill on religious grounds.
research_questions.question_en: How do religious gatekeepers, such as general practitioners and pharmacists, affect the availability of the Pill?

research_questions.question: How do moral preferences surrounding the liberalization of the birth control pill impact women’s family formation, education, labor market outcomes, and wealth?
research_questions.witness: Our study is the first to consider how moral preferences surrounding the liberalization of the birth control pill might impact women’s family formation, education, labor market outcomes, and wealth.
research_questions.question_en: How do moral preferences surrounding the liberalization of the birth control pill impact women’s family formation, education, labor market outcomes, and wealth?

research_questions.question: What is the impact of supply-side moral preferences of gatekeepers (doctors and pharmacists) on the benefits of birth control liberalization for women?
research_questions.witness: We show that the positive impacts of birth control liberalization on women’s outcomes cancel out as more gatekeepers were morally opposed to providing the Pill.
research_questions.question_en: What is the impact of supply-side moral preferences of gatekeepers (doctors and pharmacists) on the benefits of birth control liberalization for women?

research_questions.question: What are the short- and long-run effects of liberalizing access to oral contraceptives in the Netherlands?
research_questions.witness: We can thus explore both short- and long-run effects for cohorts who are precisely defined in age and location at the time of the policy change.
research_questions.question_en: What are the short- and long-run effects of liberalizing access to oral contraceptives in the Netherlands?

research_questions.question: What is the effect of different adverse life events on individuals’ income trajectories?
research_questions.witness: This paper studies and compares the effect of different adverse life events – job loss, disability and health shocks, divorce and spousal death – on individuals’ income trajectories.
research_questions.question_en: What is the effect of different adverse life events on individuals’ income trajectories?

research_questions.question: How does the tax and transfer system provide public insurance against shocks caused by adverse life events?
research_questions.witness: We compare their effect on primary and disposable household income in order to measure the public insurance to the shocks provided by the tax and transfer system.
research_questions.question_en: How does the tax and transfer system provide public insurance against shocks caused by adverse life events?

research_questions.question: Does the importance of government insurance vary with the severity of the shock on primary income?
research_questions.witness: Both between different events and within different groups for a given event, we find that the importance of government insurance increases with the severity of the shock on primary income.
research_questions.question_en: Does the importance of government insurance vary with the severity of the shock on primary income?

research_questions.question: Are certain groups of the population relatively less protected against adverse life events?
research_questions.witness: However, we find that certain groups of the population are relatively less protected against adverse life events, such as young people facing a large health shock or secondary earners facing a divorce.
research_questions.question_en: Are certain groups of the population relatively less protected against adverse life events?

research_questions.question: What is the effect of adverse life events on income trajectories?
research_questions.witness: Given the broad set of life events we consider, this paper relates to the different strands of the social sciences literature studying the causal effect of those events on income trajectories.
research_questions.question_en: What is the effect of adverse life events on income trajectories?

research_questions.question: How does the tax and transfer system provide insurance against income drops caused by adverse life events?
research_questions.witness: Third, we find that this gap is largely reduced when considering after-tax income: public insurance – through both taxes and benefits – plays a big role in protecting individuals from all adverse events, but the degree of insurance provided increases with the severity of the shock.
research_questions.question_en: How does the tax and transfer system provide insurance against income drops caused by adverse life events?

research_questions.question: Are there differences in the impact of adverse life events and the level of protection across different population groups?
research_questions.witness: Finally, we find that some categories of the population are relatively less protected against adverse life-events.
research_questions.question_en: Are there differences in the impact of adverse life events and the level of protection across different population groups?

research_questions.question: How do the effects of different adverse life events compare in terms of income trajectories and insurance provided?
research_questions.witness: Rather than analysing each event separately, the novelty of this paper lies in the comparison across events made possible by the harmonised research design we implement.
research_questions.question_en: How do the effects of different adverse life events compare in terms of income trajectories and insurance provided?

In previous efforts, it has proven difficult to distinguish actual firm entries from administrative events, such as mergers and restructurings (Bosma et al., 2011), or to separate starting firms from incumbent firms opening a new branch (Andersson and Noseleit, 2011). These data restrictions increase the likelihood that firm entry figures are overestimated (See for instance Dejardin (2011); Neffke et al. (2011); Asturias et al. (2017)). The administrative microdata used in this study contains information about the reason why a newly appearing firm is started or terminated, which enables us to separate real entry events from administrative events.

data_mentions.witness: To be able to differentiate between the two types of displacement, either being forced to work in Germany or being forced to go into hiding, I link archival data on forced workers in Germany to the Dutch census data.

To estimate the consequences of being conscripted into the forced labor system, I use individual-level admin data from the 1971 census (14de Algemene Volkstelling) which is a comprehensive census of the Dutch population.

The estimates for the share of Dutch forced workers who died in Germany range between 0.9% and 6.4%, meaning that the majority survived the coercion (Beening, 2003; CBS, 1947; Spoerer, 2001; Warmbrunn, 1972).
To investigate the consequences on mental health, I use Eurobarometer survey data which includes a question on self-reported life satisfaction.

research_questions.question: What are the long-term labor market consequences of exposure to forced labor conscription?
research_questions.witness: I study the long-run consequences of facing labor coercion on individual labor market success, based on the historical system of forced labor set up by Germany during World War II (WWII).
research_questions.question_en: What are the long-term labor market consequences of exposure to forced labor conscription?

research_questions.question: How does the sector of conscription affect the ability of individuals to reintegrate into the workforce?
research_questions.witness: My findings suggest that the negative impact on labor force participation is mitigated when individuals are conscripted to work in sectors that are also present in the Netherlands, which enhances their ability to reintegrate into the workforce.
research_questions.question_en: How does the sector of conscription affect the ability of individuals to reintegrate into the workforce?

research_questions.question: What is the impact of forced labor conscription during WWII on later educational attainment, income, and employment status?
research_questions.witness: Using exogenous variation in conscription rates across birth dates, I compare the later educational attainment, income, and employment status of individuals in conscripted cohorts to those born before the conscripted years of birth.
research_questions.question_en: What is the impact of forced labor conscription during WWII on later educational attainment, income, and employment status?

research_questions.question: Does the type of displacement (forced labor in Germany or going into hiding) affect labor market outcomes differently?
research_questions.witness: To be able to differentiate between the two types of displacement, either being forced to work in Germany or being forced to go into hiding, I link archival data on forced workers in Germany to the Dutch census data.
research_questions.question_en: Does the type of displacement (forced labor in Germany or going into hiding) affect labor market outcomes differently?

research_questions.question: How does exposure to adverse living conditions in Germany affect labor market success and health outcomes later in life?
research_questions.witness: Exploiting information from the archival records on forced workers’ locations in Germany, I show that the negative consequences on later labor market success are driven by individuals who had higher exposure to adverse living conditions while in Germany.
research_questions.question_en: How does exposure to adverse living conditions in Germany affect labor market success and health outcomes later in life?

research_questions.question: Did the post-WWII baby boom in the Netherlands compensate for the births that did not occur during WWII and the interwar period?
research_questions.witness: Specifically, in the context of the Netherlands, I show that the post-WWII peak in fertility did not compensate for births that did not occur during WWII and the interwar period.
research_questions.question_en: Did the post-WWII baby boom in the Netherlands compensate for the births that did not occur during WWII and the interwar period?

research_questions.question: Was the post-WWII fertility increase in the Netherlands due to a tempo effect (postponement of births) or a quantum effect (reduced completed fertility)?
research_questions.witness: This is important because two effects could be at play. The post-war fertility response could be explained by a tempo effect if births were postponed to after the war. However, if births do (not) occur because of the prevailing conditions there could be a quantum effect on cohort-fertility, warranting a different interpretation of a fertility increase after the war.
research_questions.question_en: Was the post-WWII fertility increase in the Netherlands due to a tempo effect (postponement of births) or a quantum effect (reduced completed fertility)?

research_questions.question: What were the lifecycle effects of WWII on fertility in the Netherlands?
research_questions.witness: To explore the lifecycle effects of WWII, I exploit that women in different cohorts experienced the war at different ages.
research_questions.question_en: What were the lifecycle effects of WWII on fertility in the Netherlands?

research_questions.question: How can the bunching method be used to estimate the counterfactual distribution of births in the absence of the war?
research_questions.witness: I propose an application of the bunching methodology to estimate a counterfactual distribution of births for each cohort of mothers.
research_questions.question_en: How can the bunching method be used to estimate the counterfactual distribution of births in the absence of the war?

research_questions.question: What was the impact of the war on fertility decisions, while abstracting from the mechanical effects of famine and a (temporary) absence of men?
research_questions.witness: This aspect also allows me to zoom in on the effects of the war on fertility decisions while abstracting from the mechanical effects of famine and a (temporary) absence of men on fertility.
research_questions.question_en: What was the impact of the war on fertility decisions, while abstracting from the mechanical effects of famine and a (temporary) absence of men?

research_questions.question: How does the Dutch post-war fertility response compare to other countries, particularly the United States?
research_questions.witness: The Dutch setting is more representative of the post-war fertility response observed in other countries.
research_questions.question_en: How does the Dutch post-war fertility response compare to other countries, particularly the United States?

research_questions.question: How can the bunching method be used to distinguish between the opposing schools of thought explaining the baby boom in the United States?
research_questions.witness: I am the first to use the bunching method to shed light on the two hotly debated opposing schools of thought explaining the baby boom in the United States — i.e., Becker (1960, 1965) versus Easterlin (1966, 1971, 1987).
research_questions.question_en: How can the bunching method be used to distinguish between the opposing schools of thought explaining the baby boom in the United States?

research_questions.question: What is the magnitude of 'missed births' due to the war for different cohorts?
research_questions.witness: I estimate that 255,472 fewer children are born compared to the counterfactual for cohorts 1905–1924, which is 9.4% of the actual number of births for these cohorts.
research_questions.question_en: What is the magnitude of 'missed births' due to the war for different cohorts?

In hoofdstuk 3 laten we resultaten zien op basis van de Enquête Beroepsbevolking nieuwe reeks (Ebbnw) en in hoofdstuk 4 op basis van de Nationale Enquête Arbeidsomstandigheden (NEA) en de Spolisbus.
De NEA is een steekproefonderzoek met een omvang van ongeveer 61.000 respondenten.
In hoofdstuk 2 geven we op basis van data van het UWV de spanning op de arbeidsmarkt weer.
Voor het aantal gediplomeerden van mbo-, hbo- en wo-sportopleidingen van 2015-2023 gebruiken we peildatum 1 oktober. Deze data zijn afkomstig van DUO.

In paragraaf 5.2 kijken we naar ervaringen van gediplomeerden van zes mbo- en twee hbo-sportopleidingen. Hierbij gebruiken we de Kerncijfers Schoolverlatersonderzoeken van het ROA, via Arbeidsmarkt Informatie Systeem Online (AIS).
Tekortsectoren zoals zorg, onderwijs, kinderopvang en techniek staan daarbij structureel onder druk. Ook stegen de lonen sterker dan in voorgaande jaren (CBS, 2025).
In de afgelopen jaren is het aandeel werknemers met een vast contract verder gegroeid. Werkgevers kiezen vaker voor zekerheid om personeel te behouden en verloop te beperken (CBS, 2024).
Tegelijk blijft deeltijdwerk dominant: Nederland is al jaren Europees koploper deeltijd en dat verandert nauwelijks (Eurostat, 2025).
Daarnaast is het aantal zzp’ers in verschillende sectoren licht gedaald (CBS, 2025a).
Een duidelijke ontwikkeling is de groei van de groep onderbenutte deeltijders: werkenden die meer uren willen en kunnen maken (CBS, 2025b).

research_questions.question: Is the urban wage growth premium caused by human capital spillovers or by sorting of workers and firms?
research_questions.witness: This article challenges the conventional view that faster wage growth for urban workers is caused by human capital spillovers. Instead, we find that the positive association between city size and individual wage growth is to a large extent driven by sorting of workers and firms, with inherently higher wage growth, into bigger cities.
research_questions.question_en: Is the urban wage growth premium caused by human capital spillovers or by sorting of workers and firms?

research_questions.question: Which workers experience significant urban wage growth benefits after controlling for spatial sorting?
research_questions.witness: Having controlled for spatial sorting, we conclude that only young workers experience significant urban wage growth benefits.
research_questions.question_en: Which workers experience significant urban wage growth benefits after controlling for spatial sorting?

research_questions.question: What is the role of spatial sorting in explaining the urban wage premium?
research_questions.witness: This article’s main contribution is to extend the wage equation proposed by De la Roca and Puga (2017) by accounting for individual-, industry- and firm size-specific differences in wage growth.
research_questions.question_en: What is the role of spatial sorting in explaining the urban wage premium?

research_questions.question: How do wage level and growth effects of urban areas differ among different types of workers?
research_questions.witness: Furthermore, this article shows that the wage-agglomeration elasticities, as applicable to the complete sample, conceal large heterogeneities among different types of workers.
research_questions.question_en: How do wage level and growth effects of urban areas differ among different types of workers?

research_questions.question: What is the prevalence of chronic kidney disease in the Netherlands?
research_questions.witness: In 2021, about 8.5% of the people aged 18 years and older known in primary care were found to have chronic kidney disease, i.e., about 1 in 12 adults in general practitioners practices were found to have chronic kidney disease, which is about 1.2 million people in total.
research_questions.question_en: What is the prevalence of chronic kidney disease in the Netherlands?

research_questions.question: What are the differences in prevalence of chronic kidney disease by age group?
research_questions.witness: Many more people older than 75 years had chronic kidney disease compared to those aged 75 years and younger (42.5% in those older than 75 years, 10.8% in those aged 55-75, and 0.9% in those aged less than 55 years in 2021).
research_questions.question_en: What are the differences in prevalence of chronic kidney disease by age group?

research_questions.question: What are the differences in prevalence of chronic kidney disease by income level?
research_questions.witness: People with an annual household income of less than 27.000 euros had a higher prevalence of chronic kidney disease (12.3% or more in 2021) compared to those with a household income of more than 27.000 euros (8.4% or less in 2021).
research_questions.question_en: What are the differences in prevalence of chronic kidney disease by income level?

research_questions.question: What is the incidence of chronic kidney disease in the Netherlands?
research_questions.witness: With an incidence of about 1.0%, nearly 130,000 people were newly identified with chronic kidney disease in the year 2021.
research_questions.question_en: What is the incidence of chronic kidney disease in the Netherlands?

research_questions.question: What are the differences in incidence of chronic kidney disease by age group?
research_questions.witness: People older than 75 years had a higher incidence of chronic kidney disease (3.9% in 2021) than those aged 75 years and younger (1.4% in those aged 55-75 and 0.1% in those younger than 55 years in 2021).
research_questions.question_en: What are the differences in incidence of chronic kidney disease by age group?

research_questions.question: What is the percentage of people with existing chronic kidney disease (prevalence) and the percentage of people newly identified with chronic kidney disease each year (incidence) between 2016 and 2021 among adults (18 years and older) registered in primary care?
research_questions.witness: This report presents data on the percentage of people with existing chronic kidney disease (i.e., prevalence) and the percentage of people newly identified with chronic kidney disease each year (i.e., incidence) between 2016 and 2021 among adults (18 years and older) registered in primary care.
research_questions.question_en: What is the percentage of people with existing chronic kidney disease (prevalence) and the percentage of people newly identified with chronic kidney disease each year (incidence) between 2016 and 2021 among adults (18 years and older) registered in primary care?

research_questions.question: What is the percentage of people with commonly accompanied health conditions, the percentage of people on treatment for key risk factors, including diabetes mellitus and hypertension, and the rate of death in people with and without chronic kidney disease?
research_questions.witness: The reports also present data on the percentage of people with commonly accompanied health conditions, the percentage of people on treatment for key risk factors, including diabetes mellitus and hypertension, and the rate of death in people with and without chronic kidney disease.
research_questions.question_en: What is the percentage of people with commonly accompanied health conditions, the percentage of people on treatment for key risk factors, including diabetes mellitus and hypertension, and the rate of death in people with and without chronic kidney disease?

research_questions.question: What are the differences in prevalence of chronic kidney disease by region?
research_questions.witness: The prevalence of chronic kidney disease was highest in the Southern region (Zeeland, Noord-Brabant, Limburg) (9.7% in 2021) and lowest in the Western region (Utrecht, Noord-Holland, Zuid-Holland) (7.6% in 2021) of the Netherlands.
research_questions.question_en: What are the differences in prevalence of chronic kidney disease by region?

research_questions.question: Does the transition from registered partnership to marriage render same-sex relationships more stable?
research_questions.witness: We ﬁnd that indeed after transforming into marriage, relationships became more stable than previous registered partnerships.
research_questions.question_en: Does the transition from registered partnership to marriage render same-sex relationships more stable?

research_questions.question: What is the causal treatment effect of getting married on the stability of same-sex relationships?
research_questions.witness: Therefore, we can establish a causal treatment eﬀect of getting married on the stability of same-sex relationships.
research_questions.question_en: What is the causal treatment effect of getting married on the stability of same-sex relationships?

research_questions.question: How does same-sex marriage legislation affect existing registered partnerships?
research_questions.witness: We also ﬁnd that same-sex marriage legislation increased separation of existing registered partnerships from before the legalization while at the same time initiating the transition to marriage.
research_questions.question_en: How does same-sex marriage legislation affect existing registered partnerships?

research_questions.question: Are same-sex marriages more stable than same-sex registered partnerships formed post-legalization?
research_questions.witness: Comparing the stability of same-sex marriages and same-sex registered partnerships formed post-legalization, we ﬁnd that marriages are more stable.
research_questions.question_en: Are same-sex marriages more stable than same-sex registered partnerships formed post-legalization?

research_questions.question: Does marriage have a causal effect on partnership stability?
research_questions.witness: With competing alternative types of partnership, it is interesting to find out whether marriage currently only has a symbolic meaning and whether it has a causal effect on partnership stability.
research_questions.question_en: Does marriage have a causal effect on partnership stability?

research_questions.question_en: What is the effect of same-sex marriage legalization on the stability of same-sex formal partnerships?

research_questions.question: Do households exhibit bunching behavior around kinks and notches in the Dutch system of cash transfers?
research_questions.witness: We study the behavioural responses to kinks and notches in the Dutch system of cash transfers, using data on the universe of Dutch households for the period 2007–2014.
research_questions.question_en: Do households exhibit bunching behavior around kinks and notches in the Dutch system of cash transfers?

research_questions.question: What potential mechanisms can explain the apparent lack of bunching around kinks and notches in the Dutch system of cash transfers?
research_questions.witness: We consider potential mechanisms that can explain this apparent lack of bunching.
research_questions.question_en: What potential mechanisms can explain the apparent lack of bunching around kinks and notches in the Dutch system of cash transfers?

research_questions.question: Is there evidence of bunching in taxable income at the kinks and notches in the housing benefit scheme?
research_questions.witness: Our main ﬁndings are as follows. First, we generally ﬁnd no evidence of bunching in taxable income at the kinks and notches in the housing beneﬁt scheme, independent of household type or mode of employment.
research_questions.question_en: Is there evidence of bunching in taxable income at the kinks and notches in the housing benefit scheme?

research_questions.question: Is there evidence of bunching in taxable wealth for the notch in the health care scheme and child benefit scheme?
research_questions.witness: Second, we ﬁnd no evidence of bunching in taxable wealth for the notch in the health care scheme and child beneﬁt scheme.
research_questions.question_en: Is there evidence of bunching in taxable wealth for the notch in the health care scheme and child benefit scheme?

research_questions.question: What could explain the lack of bunching observed in the study?
research_questions.witness: The lack of bunching could be a result of either a low structural elasticity or high optimisation frictions.
research_questions.question_en: What could explain the lack of bunching observed in the study?

research_questions.question: Are there efficiency losses from targeted cash transfers?
research_questions.witness: On the upside, these results suggest that the eﬃciency losses from targeted cash transfers may be limited, at least to the extent we can measure them close to the kink or notch.
research_questions.question_en: Are there efficiency losses from targeted cash transfers?

research_questions.question: What are the implications of large kinks and notches in the implicit social welfare weights?
research_questions.witness: Furthermore, large kinks and notches imply large diﬀerences in the implicit social welfare weights for households that diﬀer only slightly in their taxable income or wealth, which is inconsistent with a well-behaved social welfare function (Jacobs et al., 2017).
research_questions.question_en: What are the implications of large kinks and notches in the implicit social welfare weights?

research_questions.question: Is there evidence of gradual learning by households?
research_questions.witness: We ﬁnd no evidence of gradual learning by households, as households remain in dominated regions for several years.
research_questions.question_en: Is there evidence of gradual learning by households?

research_questions.question: Does influenza vaccination have an impact on long-term mortality in the elderly?
research_questions.witness: In this study we assessed the long-term outcome of influenza vaccination on mortality in the elderly by conducting a 25-year follow-up study of a RCT on the efficacy of influenza vaccination as baseline.
research_questions.question_en: Does influenza vaccination have an impact on long-term mortality in the elderly?

research_questions.question: Is there a difference in all-cause mortality between the influenza vaccination and placebo groups?
research_questions.witness: Single influenza vaccination did not reduce all-cause mortality when compared to placebo (adjusted HR 0.95, 95% CI 0.85−1.05).
research_questions.question_en: Is there a difference in all-cause mortality between the influenza vaccination and placebo groups?

research_questions.question: Are there age-related differences in the effects of influenza vaccination on mortality?
research_questions.witness: In those aged 60–64, median survival increased with 20.1 months (95% CI 2.4–37.9), although no effects on all-cause mortality (adjusted HR 0.86, 95% CI 0.72−1.03) could be demonstrated in survival analysis.
research_questions.question_en: Are there age-related differences in the effects of influenza vaccination on mortality?

research_questions.question: Does influenza vaccination reduce mortality in the long term in community-dwelling elderly?
research_questions.witness: Evaluating the long-term outcome of vaccination is relevant since it contributes to the evidence of the effects on mortality from a long-term perspective and might support patient and policy decision making.
research_questions.question_en: Does influenza vaccination reduce mortality in the long term in community-dwelling elderly?

research_questions.question: What are the long-term effects of influenza vaccination on mortality and underlying causes of death in the elderly?
research_questions.witness: Therefore, we have used our 1991 trial as baseline for a long-term follow-up study to explore the long-term outcome of influenza vaccination on mortality and underlying causes of death in community-dwelling elderly.
research_questions.question_en: What are the long-term effects of influenza vaccination on mortality and underlying causes of death in the elderly?

research_questions.question: Does the duration of temporary contracts affect their function as stepping stones to permanent employment?
research_questions.witness: Our study evaluates whether this stepping-stone function is moderated by the contract duration, exploiting a Dutch policy reform that shortened the maximum duration of sequences of temporary contracts with the same employers from 3 years to 2 years.
research_questions.question_en: Does the duration of temporary contracts affect their function as stepping stones to permanent employment?

title: Antwoord op Vragen van leden Dassen en Patijn over het rapport ‘Verkenning wettelijk minimumjeugdloon’ en de rapportage van onderzoeksbureau Blauw ‘Jongeren en het minimumjeugdloon’ | Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal

research_questions.question: Waarom is een aanvaardbare tegenprestatie voor mensen tot 21 jaar lager dan voor mensen vanaf 21 jaar, zeker als de productiviteit over alle leeftijden ongeveer gelijk is?
research_questions.witness: In de verkenning wordt gezegd dat het doel van het minimumjeugdloon is om te bepalen wat een aanvaardbare tegenprestatie is, kunt u uitleggen waarom een aanvaardbare tegenprestatie voor mensen tot 21 jaar lager is dan voor mensen vanaf 21 jaar? Zeker als uit onderzoek blijkt dat de productiviteit ongeveer hetzelfde is over alle leeftijden?
research_questions.question_en: Why is an acceptable counter-performance for people under 21 years lower than for people aged 21 and older, especially since productivity is roughly equal across all ages?

research_questions.question: Waarom worden de lagere werkloosheid en minder vroegtijdig schoolverlaters nog steeds als redenen aangedragen om het jeugdloon in stand te houden, terwijl er geen aantoonbaar verband is tussen het jeugdloon en deze effecten?
research_questions.witness: In de verkenning wordt geconstateerd dat er geen aantoonbaar verband is tussen het jeugdloon en een lagere werkloosheid en minder vroegtijdig schoolverlaters, dit verband is niet gevonden bij eerdere verlagingen en ook internationaal gezien niet, waarom worden die twee zaken dan nog steeds als redenen aangedragen om het jeugdloon in stand te houden?
research_questions.question_en: Why are lower unemployment and fewer early school leavers still cited as reasons to maintain the youth wage, despite there being no demonstrable link between the youth wage and these effects?

research_questions.question: Hoe rijmt het feit dat studenten moeite hebben met rondkomen met de conclusies in het onderzoek van Blauw?
research_questions.witness: Constaterende dat in de verkenning staat dat studenten en onderwijsinstellingen zien dat studenten moeite hebben met rond komen, MBO-studenten geven aan dat 45% van de MBO- studenten niet kan rondkomen, een kwart kampt met schulden en betalingsachterstanden en voelen bovengemiddeld veel druk en dat vertegenwoordigers van Hbo-studenten stellen dat zij veel financiële stress ervaren wat hun welzijn onder druk zet, hoe rijmt u dit met de conclusies in het onderzoek van Blauw?
research_questions.question_en: How does the fact that students have difficulty making ends meet relate to the conclusions in Blauw's research?

research_questions.question: Wat vindt u van de constatering in de verkenning dat jongeren tussen 15 en 20 jaar in andere landen meer verdienen en dat jongeren van 18 in de meeste landen significant meer verdienen?
research_questions.witness: In internationaal perspectief zien we in de verkenning dat jongeren tussen 15 en 20 jaar in andere landen meer verdienen en dat jongeren van 18 in de meeste landen significant meer verdienen, wat vindt u van deze twee constateringen in de verkenning?
research_questions.question_en: What do you think of the finding in the exploration that young people aged 15 to 20 earn more in other countries and that 18-year-olds earn significantly more in most countries?

title:
Essays on industry relatedness: Productivity spillovers through labor flows, diversification and agglomeration economies
      -  Erasmus University Rotterdam

data_mentions.mention: Hungarian employee-employer linked panel data from 2003-2011
data_mentions.witness: Hungarian employee-employer linked panel data from 2003-2011 imply that the productivity gap rules out the effect of multinational spillovers.

link.mention: Hungarian employee-employer linked panel data from 2003-2011

data_mentions.witness: Findings reveal that urbanization and diversity are positively associated with firm productivity, even when controlling for current productivity. This effect is no longer sustained when human capital and work experience of new hires of a more efficient production is controlled for. This may point to a mechanism through which urbanization affects productivity spillovers through attracting and selecting skilled workers into the region, who can then learn from each other facilitated by the urban setting; furthermore the diversity of the workforce also fosters this learning process. Robustness checks on subsamples reveal that agglomeration effects are most pronounced for small firms in years of average productivity growth.

research_questions.question: To what extent do productivity spillovers through labor flows depend on the productivity gap, multinational experience, and industry relatedness?
research_questions.witness: The first essay aims to disentangle the effects of productivity gap, multinational experience and industry relatedness in a common framework.
research_questions.question_en: To what extent do productivity spillovers through labor flows depend on the productivity gap, multinational experience, and industry relatedness?

research_questions.question: How does product diversification relate to technological relatedness, and how do firms adjust their product portfolios during demand crises?
research_questions.witness: The second essay examines the connection of product diversification with relatedness.
research_questions.question_en: How does product diversification relate to technological relatedness, and how do firms adjust their product portfolios during demand crises?

research_questions.question: How are firm-level sorting effects of labor flows conditioned by agglomeration, and what role do urbanization and diversity play in productivity spillovers?
research_questions.witness: The third essay builds on the first essay on productivity spillovers to investigate to what extent the firm-level sorting effects of labor flows – new hires with an experience of a more efficient production or in a technologically related industry – are conditioned by agglomeration.
research_questions.question_en: How are firm-level sorting effects of labor flows conditioned by agglomeration, and what role do urbanization and diversity play in productivity spillovers?

research_questions.question: How does product-specific demand shocks affect the diversification of firms in terms of technological relatedness?
research_questions.witness: To test this hypothesis, we look at the effect of product-specific demand shocks on product portfolios of Hungarian firms in the 2005-2012 period.
research_questions.question_en: How does product-specific demand shocks affect the diversification of firms in terms of technological relatedness?

research_questions.question: To what extent are firm-level sorting effects of labor flows conditioned by agglomeration?
research_questions.witness: The third essay builds on the first essay on productivity spillovers to investigate to what extent the firm-level sorting effects of labor flows – new hires with an experience of a more efficient production or in a technologically related industry – are conditioned by agglomeration;
research_questions.question_en: To what extent are firm-level sorting effects of labor flows conditioned by agglomeration?

title:

      -  Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

research_questions.question: Which groups are most at risk of entering disability insurance (DI)?
research_questions.witness: To gain insights into which groups are most at risk of entering DI, what measures can be taken to prevent this, and how to support them to return to work, this dissertation consists of four chapters that empirically analyse the process from the onset of health problems, through the DI application until the potential recovery of DI recipients in the Netherlands.
research_questions.question_en: Which groups are most at risk of entering disability insurance (DI)?

research_questions.question: What measures can be taken to prevent individuals from entering DI and support them to return to work?
research_questions.witness: To gain insights into which groups are most at risk of entering DI, what measures can be taken to prevent this, and how to support them to return to work, this dissertation consists of four chapters that empirically analyse the process from the onset of health problems, through the DI application until the potential recovery of DI recipients in the Netherlands.
research_questions.question_en: What measures can be taken to prevent individuals from entering DI and support them to return to work?

research_questions.question: How can the design and implementation of the health care and DI systems be improved to retain people in the workforce and reduce the number of DI recipients?
research_questions.witness: From a policy perspective, this suggests that there is still room for improvements in the design and implementation of the health care and DI systems in order to retain people in the workforce and reduce the number of DI recipients.
research_questions.question_en: How can the design and implementation of the health care and DI systems be improved to retain people in the workforce and reduce the number of DI recipients?

research_questions.question: How can the inflow into DI and work resumption be explained across different groups?
research_questions.witness: All chapters of this thesis confirm that while experiencing health issues might be a necessary condition for applying for DI, it is certainly not a sufficient condition to explain differentials in the inflow into DI or work resumption across groups.
research_questions.question_en: How can the inflow into DI and work resumption be explained across different groups?

research_questions.question: Wat is de impact van de coronapandemie op de overgang van jongeren van het onderwijs naar de arbeidsmarkt?
research_questions.witness: Dit is het eindrapport van het tweejarige monitoronderzoek naar de invloed van de coronapandemie (maart 2020 tot en met december 2021) op de overgang van het onderwijs naar de arbeidsmarkt.
research_questions.question_en: What is the impact of the coronavirus pandemic on the transition of young people from education to the labor market?

research_questions.question: Welke groepen jongeren zijn harder getroffen door de coronapandemie in termen van baankansen?
research_questions.witness: Uit verdiepende analyses blijkt dat jongeren zonder startkwalificatie, jongeren met maximaal een mbo-2-opleiding, jongeren met een niet-westerse migratieachtergrond en jongeren met een gezondheidsbeperking relatief lagere baankansen hebben en dat deze kansen ook minder herstellen na de lockdowns.
research_questions.question_en: Which groups of youth have been more affected by the coronavirus pandemic in terms of employment opportunities?

research_questions.question: Hoe heeft de coronapandemie de uitstroom uit het onderwijs beïnvloed?
research_questions.witness: Het aantal jongeren dat jaarlijks vanuit het onderwijs de arbeidsmarkt opstroomt is na een stijging in de afgelopen jaren tijdens de coronapandemie afgenomen: respectievelijk 22 duizend en 15 duizend jongeren in 2020 en 2021.
research_questions.question_en: How has the coronavirus pandemic influenced the outflow from education?

research_questions.question: Wat zijn de ervaringen van jongeren die tijdens de coronapandemie de arbeidsmarkt opkwamen?
research_questions.witness: Uit verdiepende interviews met jongeren die tijdens de coronapandemie de arbeidsmarkt opkomen blijkt dat zij gedurende lockdowns hebben ervaren dat er weinig tot geen vacatures beschikbaar zijn en beloftes van betaalde aanstellingen tijdens stages niet zijn ingelost vanwege lockdowns.
research_questions.question_en: What are the experiences of young people who entered the labor market during the coronavirus pandemic?

research_questions.question: Hoe heeft de coronapandemie de overgang van onderwijs naar arbeidsmarkt voor jongeren beïnvloed?
research_questions.witness: Uit de literatuurstudie blijkt dat de overgang van onderwijs naar arbeidsmarkt niet voor alle jongeren even succesvol verloopt en afhangt van verschillende factoren die door de pandemie worden uitvergroot.
research_questions.question_en: How has the coronavirus pandemic influenced the transition from education to the labor market for young people?

research_questions.question: Wat is de impact van de coronapandemie op de baankansen van jongeren met verschillende opleidingsniveaus?
research_questions.witness: Tegelijkertijd is de ongelijkheid in baankansen tussen opleidingsniveaus toegenomen en stellen jongeren hun arbeidsmarktintrede uit.
research_questions.question_en: What is the impact of the coronavirus pandemic on the employment prospects of young people with different educational levels?

research_questions.question: Hoe heeft de coronapandemie de uitstroom van jongeren uit het onderwijs beïnvloed?
research_questions.witness: Daarnaast zijn er in 2020 ongeveer 23.000 jongeren langer in het onderwijs gebleven dan verwacht.
research_questions.question_en: How has the coronavirus pandemic influenced the outflow of young people from education?

title:
ADAM33 gene polymorphisms and mortality: A prospective cohort study
      -  the University of Groningen research portal

research_questions.question: Is the ADAM33 gene associated with all-cause, COPD, and cardiovascular mortality?
research_questions.witness: In this study we investigated all-cause, COPD and cardiovascular mortality, in relation to single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in ADAM33 (Q_1, S_1, S_2, T_1 and T_2) that were genotyped in 1,390 subjects from the Vlagtwedde/Vlaardingen cohort.
research_questions.question_en: Is the ADAM33 gene associated with all-cause, COPD, and cardiovascular mortality?

research_questions.question: What is the risk of all-cause and cardiovascular mortality associated with specific ADAM33 gene polymorphisms?
research_questions.witness: Individuals homozygous for the minor allele of SNP T_2 had an increased risk of all-cause and cardiovascular mortality compared to wild types: hazard ratio 3.6 (95% confidence interval 2.0 to 6.7) and 3.4 (1.2 to 9.5) respectively.
research_questions.question_en: What is the risk of all-cause and cardiovascular mortality associated with specific ADAM33 gene polymorphisms?

research_questions.question: Does the risk of all-cause mortality associated with ADAM33 gene polymorphisms vary by gender and smoking habits?
research_questions.witness: In stratified analyses the risk of all-cause mortality associated with SNP T_2 did not change: females 3.5 (1.5 to 8.3), males 3.1 (1.2 to 7.6), never smokers 3.8 (0.9 to 16.3), ever smokers 3.6 (1.8 to 7.2).
research_questions.question_en: Does the risk of all-cause mortality associated with ADAM33 gene polymorphisms vary by gender and smoking habits?

research_questions.question: How do specific ADAM33 gene polymorphisms (SNPs) relate to mortality risks?
research_questions.witness: Using Cox proportional hazards regression we estimated the risk of the SNPs in relation to mortality, adjusting for gender, age, FEV1, height, place of residence and packyears of smoking.
research_questions.question_en: How do specific ADAM33 gene polymorphisms (SNPs) relate to mortality risks?

research_questions.question: Wat zijn de gevolgen van de Blankenburgverbinding voor de regionale woningmarkt?
research_questions.witness: Dat constateren onderzoekers Rosa van der Drift, Harry Boumeester en Harry van der Heijden van de TU Delft in hun artikel ‘De Blankenburgverbinding: de gevolgen voor de regionale woningmarkt’ in het kwartaalblad Real Estate Research Quarterly van de Vereniging van Onroerendgoedonderzoekers Nederland (VOGON).
research_questions.question_en: What are the consequences of the Blankenburg connection for the regional housing market?

research_questions.question: Hoe beïnvloedt de Blankenburgverbinding de vraag naar woningen en de koopprijzen?
research_questions.witness: De Delftse onderzoekers beschrijven vooraf de impact van de Blankenburgverbinding op de woningmarkt in de regio. De uitkomsten wijzen erop dat de regio’s ten zuidwesten van de snelwegtunnel aanzienlijk aantrekkelijker worden.
research_questions.question_en: How does the Blankenburg connection influence the demand for housing and purchase prices?

research_questions.question: Wat zijn de indirecte effecten van de Blankenburgverbinding op de woningmarkt?
research_questions.witness: Bovendien kunnen door de verbeterde bereikbaarheid andere indirecte effecten op de woningmarkt optreden, zoals veranderingen in economische bedrijvigheid in de noordelijke of zuidelijke regio.
research_questions.question_en: What are the indirect effects of the Blankenburg connection on the housing market?

research_questions.question: Hoe beïnvloedt de tolheffing op korte en lange termijn de vraag naar woningen?
research_questions.witness: Tolheffing tempert vraag. Op de korte termijn wordt de groei van deze vraag enigszins getemperd door tolheffing voor het gebruik van de Blankenburgverbinding, wat de aantrekkelijkheid van woningen bij de verbinding iets vermindert.
research_questions.question_en: How does the housing benefit affect the demand for housing in the short and long term?

research_questions.question: What are the health effects of long-term exposure to ultrafine particles from air traffic around Schiphol?
research_questions.witness: RIVM has investigated the health effects of long-term exposure to ultrafine particles.

research_questions.question: Does long-term exposure to ultrafine particles from air traffic affect the cardiovascular system?
research_questions.witness: Long-term exposure to ultrafine particles emitted by air traffic may possibly have an effect on the cardiovascular system.

research_questions.question: Does long-term exposure to ultrafine particles from air traffic affect the nervous system or cause diabetes?
research_questions.witness: There is insufficient scientific evidence to suggest that exposure to ultrafine particles from air traffic has an impact on the nervous system or causes diabetes.

research_questions.question: Does long-term exposure to ultrafine particles from air traffic lead to earlier mortality?

title: Eerstelijns Antibioticascan: het voorschrijven van antibiotica in de huisartsenpraktijk en op de huisartsenspoedpost. | Nivel

research_questions.question: Hoe volgen Nederlandse huisartsen de richtlijnen bij het voorschrijven van antibiotica?
research_questions.witness: De Eerstelijns Antibioticascan laat op basis van routinezorgdata zien dat Nederlandse huisartsen voor veel diagnoses de richtlijnen volgen bij het voorschrijven van antibiotica.
research_questions.question_en: How do Dutch general practitioners follow guidelines when prescribing antibiotics?

research_questions.question: Welke invloed hebben contextfactoren op het voorschrijven van antibiotica door Nederlandse huisartsen?
research_questions.witness: We onderzochten richtlijnnaleving op gebied van: a) frequentie van voorschrijven; b) voorgeschreven type antibioticum en c) voorgeschreven duur en dosering. Daarnaast onderzochten we de invloed van contextfactoren hierop.
research_questions.question_en: What influence do context factors have on the prescribing of antibiotics by Dutch general practitioners?

research_questions.question: Op welke diagnoses is er nog verbetering mogelijk in het voorschrijven van antibiotica?
research_questions.witness: Toch is er een aantal diagnoses waarbij er grotere variatie is tussen huisartsenpraktijken of huisartsenspoedposten. Daar zien we dat een deel van de huisartsen nog te veel antibiotica voorschrijft, of dat niet altijd het aanbevolen middel of de aanbevolen duur wordt gekozen.
research_questions.question_en: In which diagnoses is there still room for improvement in the prescribing of antibiotics?

title: Sterfte rond de geboorte | Opleiding | Volksgezondheid en Zorg

data_mentions.witness: Bron: CBS-microdata, Perined 2017-2021 gekoppeld binnen DIAPER

research_questions.question: Wat is de relatie tussen het opleidingsniveau van de moeder en de perinatale sterfte?
research_questions.witness: De perinatale sterfte verschilt per opleidingstype.
research_questions.question_en: What is the relationship between the mother's educational level and perinatal mortality?

research_questions.question: Hoe verlopen de verschillen in foetale en neonatale sterfte tussen kinderen van moeders met verschillende opleidingsniveaus?
research_questions.witness: Zowel de foetale als de neonatale sterfte in 2017 tot en met 2021 bij kinderen van moeders met basisonderwijs of een vmbo- of mbo1-opleiding is hoger dan bij kinderen van hbo of universitair geschoolde moeders en ook hoger dan bij kinderen van moeders met een havo-, vwo- of mbo2-4-opleiding.
research_questions.question_en: How do differences in fetal and neonatal mortality vary between children of mothers with different education levels?

title: Meer aandacht nodig voor leefstijl en welzijn bij transgender personen | Amsterdam UMC

research_questions.question: Wat is het sterfterisico bij transgender personen vergeleken met de algemene bevolking?
research_questions.witness: Het sterfterisico bij zowel transvrouwen als transmannen is ongeveer twee keer zo hoog als bij mannen en vrouwen in het algemeen.
research_questions.question_en: What is the risk of mortality among transgender people compared to the general population?

research_questions.question: Wat zijn de voornaamste doodsoorzaken bij transgender personen?
research_questions.witness: Uit de analyse blijkt dat het verhoogde sterfterisico bij transvrouwen vooral wordt veroorzaakt door hart- en vaatziekten, longkanker, HIV/AIDS-gerelateerde ziekten en zelfdoding.
research_questions.question_en: What are the main causes of death among transgender people?

research_questions.question: Wat zijn mogelijke manieren om het sterfterisico bij transgender personen te verminderen?
research_questions.witness: Nu blijkt dat hart- en vaatziekten, longkanker, HIV/AIDS-gerelateerde ziekten en zelfdoding de voornaamste doodsoorzaken zijn, kunnen behandelaars hun zorg hierop aanpassen.
research_questions.question_en: What are possible ways to reduce the mortality risk among transgender people?

research_questions.question_en: What is the economic contribution of copyright-relevant sectors to the Dutch economy?

research_questions.question: Waar speelt energiearmoede in Fryslân en bij welke groepen is dit een groot probleem?
research_questions.witness: De huidige stand van onderzoek laat op basis van CBS-gegevens op wijkniveau zien waar energiearmoede speelt. Maar om gerichte, effectieve maatregelen te kunnen nemen, is meer detail nodig.
research_questions.question_en: Where does energy poverty occur in Friesland and among which groups is this a major problem?

research_questions.witness: Het is de vraag of die ontwikkeling zich ook vertaalt in de mate waarin maatschappelijke groepen toegang hebben tot het vervoerssysteem in Fryslân.
research_questions.question_en: What is the level of access to the transportation system in Fryslân for different societal groups?

research_questions.question: Welke groepen en gebieden in Fryslân lopen een groter risico op vervoersarmoede?
research_questions.witness: Er is inzicht nodig bij wie, welke groepen en waar een groter risico op ferfiersearmoed is in de provincie.
research_questions.question_en: Which groups and areas in Fryslân face a higher risk of transport poverty?

research_questions.witness: Bij alle toeslagen is er onder zelfstandigen een relatief hoog niet-gebruik.
research_questions.question_en: Which groups have a relatively high share of non-use of social benefits?

title: Wel ziek, geen WIA | UWV

research_questions.question: Wat is de situatie en de kenmerken van 35-minners?
research_questions.witness: Dit syntheserapport beschrijft de situatie en de kenmerken van deze personen, hun bewegingen op de arbeidsmarkt, uitkeringsafhankelijkheid en welbevinden, hun behoefte aan dienstverlening, en de dienstverlening die ze daadwerkelijk krijgen.

title: Groot onderhoud aard van inkomen en sociaal-economische status (+ aanvullende analyse AVI o.b.v. ouders en Zvw-beta-lingsachterstanden) - SEO Economisch Onderzoek

data_mentions.witness: Het onderzoek maakt gebruik van het databestand voor de Overall Toets in de risicoverevening. Dit bestand is aangevuld met microdata van het CBS en met gegevens die zijn aangeleverd door het Zorginstituut Nederland.

research_questions.question: In hoeverre kan de verevenende werking van het risicovereveningsmodel worden verbeterd door groot onderhoud aan de bestaande kenmerken aard van inkomen en sociaal-economische status?
research_questions.witness: Dit onderzoek gaat na in hoeverre de verevenede werking van het risicovereveningsmodel kan worden verbeterd door groot onderhoud aan de bestaande kenmerken aard van inkomen en sociaaleconomische status.
research_questions.question_en: To what extent can the equalizing effect of the risk equalization model be improved by making major adjustments to the existing characteristics of income type and socio-economic status?

research_questions.question: Is een vereenvoudiging van de kenmerken aard van inkomen en sociaal-economische status mogelijk?
research_questions.witness: Tot slot is onderzocht of vereenvoudiging van de kenmerken aard van inkomen en sociaaleconomische status mogelijk is.
research_questions.question_en: Is it possible to simplify the characteristics of type of income and socio-economic status?

title: Buitenlandse seizoenarbeiders in de risicoverevening - SEO Economisch Onderzoek

research_questions.question: Wordt er overcompensatie geconstateerd voor niet-ingezeten buitenlandse seizoenarbeiders in de risicoverevening?
research_questions.witness: Zorgverzekeraars ontvangen te veel compensatie voor niet-ingezeten buitenlandse seizoenarbeiders en te weinig voor overige niet-ingezetenen.
research_questions.question_en: Is overcompensation observed for non-resident foreign seasonal workers in the risk equalization?

research_questions.question: Hoe kan de risicoverevening tussen verzekeraars verbeteren door rekening te houden met het kenmerk buitenlandse seizoenarbeider?
research_questions.witness: De verevening tussen verzekeraars kan aanzienlijk beter, als de systematiek rekening houdt met het kenmerk buitenlandse seizoenarbeider.
research_questions.question_en: How can risk equalization between insurers be improved by taking into account the characteristic of foreign seasonal workers?

research_questions.question: Wat is de impact van het verdelen van de overcompensatie van niet-ingezeten buitenlandse seizoenarbeiders over overige niet-ingezetenen?
research_questions.witness: Door de overcompensatie van niet-ingezeten buitenlandse seizoenarbeiders te verdelen over overige niet-ingezetenen, verbetert de verevenende werking van het model voor niet-ingezetenen op verzekeraarsniveau aanzienlijk.
research_questions.question_en: What is the impact of distributing the overcompensation of non-resident foreign seasonal workers among other non-residents?

title: Een economische analyse van de Tozo-regeling | CPB Website

research_questions.question: Hoe effectief was de Tozo-regeling in de periode van maart 2020 tot oktober 2021?
research_questions.witness: Het CPB onderzocht in opdracht van het ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid hoe effectief de Tozo was in de periode van maart 2020 tot oktober 2021.
research_questions.question_en: How effective was the Tozo scheme during the period from March 2020 to October 2021?

research_questions.witness: ECN heeft deze methodiek uitgewerkt om van woningbouwprojecten de energieprestatie in de praktijk te vergelijken met de geplande EPC.
research_questions.question_en: How can the energy performance of newly built homes in practice be compared to the planned EPC?

research_questions.question: What is the causal effect of paternity leave on the gender earnings gap?
research_questions.witness: In this paper, we investigate the causal effects of paternity leave on the gender earnings gap, measured by the relative labor income of women within a couple.
research_questions.question_en: What is the causal effect of paternity leave on the gender earnings gap?
